what_happened: The load-bearing new fact compiled on the first attempt: cntAt_eq_of_pend_eq's own proof already reads its hypothesis only at positions at or above the compared one, so the forward-only sharpening cntAt_eq_of_pend_eq_fwd is the same proof at a weaker hypothesis. The probe (specs/855_one_sided_open_modal_type_transport_probe/probes/01_one-sided-count-move.lean) compiled sorry-free, exit 0, no warnings, on the first run.

The prototype probe was written under this task's own probes/ directory rather than under specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/, to avoid the declared contention with the live ladder-realization task and the same-round check-evidence-probes.sh wiring obligation. Precedent: the standalone prototypes tight-chain-regime-b.lean and spanning-divisibility.lean, which the RaySummary README records as task-record prototypes rather than wired probes.

Planning was cheap because a close structural precedent exists in-tree: specs/734_e4_mosaic_stabsaturated_mixed_germ_probe/plans/01_e4-stabsaturated-mixed-germ-probe.md is the same shape of round (a task-directory prototype promoted to a wired specs/evidence/ probe, with gate wiring in the same round), and supplied the phase decomposition, the Lean Challenge Statements conventions (abbrev scaffolding is unpinned since the snapshot regex matches theorem|lemma|def|instance only; a final no-backticks prose Goals bullet carries the non-Lean work), and the Scope Hypothesis style for line-numbered gate-script anchors. The research report's three Recommendations also mapped 1:1 onto implementable phases with no re-derivation needed.

Plan executed with zero deviations across all four phases. The plan's two Scope Hypotheses both held as written: the two-state object needed exactly the declared 24 transcribed declarations with fwdC/bwdC and the parameter apparatus genuinely unnecessary (confirmed by a green compile), and admZeroC's triple-projection form rewrote cleanly against objAt (gC c0 n0) 0 so the plan's allowed fallback restatement was never needed. The gate's WIRED/WIRED_REPO counts came out at exactly the predicted 50+1.

check-evidence-probes.sh runs 51 probes through lake env lean and takes roughly 5 minutes, which exceeds the Bash tool's 180s auto-background threshold. The bounded-build-waiter single-call idiom therefore cannot complete in one call for this gate: the harness moves the call to the background mid-wait. Worked around by launching the gate detached with its PID captured to a file and then re-blocking on kill -0 against that captured PID in a following call, which preserves the waiter's liveness discipline across the two calls. No data was lost and the verdict was read correctly both times.
